Cardiology billing and coding

Cardiology claims can involve several sites of service, costly diagnostics and detailed payer criteria on one patient. We keep authorizations, modifiers and medical necessity lined up before the claim goes out.

Contact UsCall us

Billing challenges in cardiology

Prior authorization for testing

Echo and nuclear studies often need authorization, and the study performed has to match what was approved.

Global, professional and technical billing

Where the study is read and who owns the equipment decide the use of modifiers 26 and TC.

Bundled procedure components

Catheterization and interventional services have detailed NCCI rules about what can be billed separately.

Medical necessity

Coverage policies list qualifying diagnoses and indications, so the order and the note need to support them.

Codes we commonly review

These are examples, not a full list. Coverage and coding rules vary by payer, so each claim is checked against the current rules and your documentation.

  • 93000 electrocardiogram
  • 93306 complete echocardiogram
  • 78452 myocardial perfusion imaging
  • 93458 left heart catheterization
  • Modifiers 26 and TC
